name: @lucid/compliance
description: @lucid/compliance — the regulatory evidence-export contract (REQ-06). Freezes the EU AI Act Article 12 EvidencePackage / EuAiActRecord Zod schemas (tamper-evident hash chain + non-certification disclaimer); the exporter, regime templates, and AuditSource seam land in 06-04.
//optionalDependencies: @lucid/store is bound ONLY at the CLI argv boundary via a dynamic import (Assumption A1: no hard runtime dep on @lucid/store / @lucid/evolution). It is declared optional so installing @lucid/compliance as a library never pulls in the store; the CLI errors cleanly when it is absent.
